# Elementum (`@wcomp/elementum`)

> An AI-native, framework-independent UI engineering platform that connects design systems, zero-dependency Web Components, and AI agents through a shared, verifiable component contract.

## Quick Install & MCP
- npm + init CLI: `npm install @wcomp/elementum && npx @wcomp/elementum init`
- Local Markup & A11y Checker CLI: `npx @wcomp/elementum check [files-or-dirs...]`
- Zero-Build 2-Line CDN: `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/@wcomp/elementum/tokens.css" />` and `<script type="module" src="https://unpkg.com/@wcomp/elementum"></script>`
- Local MCP Server (stdio): `npx -y @wcomp/elementum` (piped stdio) or `npx -y -p @wcomp/elementum elementum-mcp`
- Hosted MCP Server (Streamable HTTP): `https://elementum-sage.vercel.app/mcp`
- Installable Agent Skills: `npx skills@latest add pinguxx/Elementum --skill elementum`

## Package Subpath Exports
- `@wcomp/elementum` — 113 Custom Elements + micro-signals (`signal`, `computed`, `effect`, `batch`, `asyncSignal`)
- `@wcomp/elementum/tokens.css` — Light & Dark W3C DTCG CSS custom properties
- `@wcomp/elementum/react` — Strictly-typed React 18 & 19 wrappers for all 113 components
- `@wcomp/elementum/ssr` — Pure Node.js Declarative Shadow DOM SSR (`renderComponentToDSD`, `renderTemplateToString`)
- `@wcomp/elementum/behaviors` — 20 composable headless interaction, focus, motion & overlay primitives
- `@wcomp/elementum/agent` — W3C WebMCP (`registerWebMCP`, `discoverFormTools`) + Shadow-DOM-piercing `snapshot(root)` and `act(root, command)`
- `@wcomp/elementum/ag-ui` — AG-UI streaming event store & RFC 6902 JSON Patch state deltas
- `@wcomp/elementum/a2ui` — Declarative A2UI JSON surface renderer with locked catalog allowlist & two-way signal bindings
- `@wcomp/elementum/testing` — WAI-ARIA APG, RTL & DSD SSR contract validators
- `@wcomp/elementum/custom-elements.json` — W3C Custom Elements Manifest

## Exact API Rules for AI Coding Agents
1. Use the 13 read-only MCP tools (`get_setup`, `list_components`, `get_component_doc`, `get_bundle_plan`, `list_tokens`, etc.), `elementum://` resources, `prompts/get`, and `completion/complete` before writing markup; validate with `validate_component_usage` and `lint_accessibility`.
2. Open/close `<el-dialog>` with `dialog.showModal()` / `dialog.close()` (not `dialog.open = true`).
3. Complex array/object props in Vanilla/Vue use `.value` signals (`table.columns.value = cols; table.data.value = rows;`); in `@wcomp/elementum/react` pass them directly as JSX props (`<ElTable columns={cols} data={rows} />`).
4. Read `e.detail?.value` on `input` / `change` / `submit` events.
5. Add `<html data-dsd>` whenever pre-rendering with `renderComponentToDSD`.
6. Use `<el-prompt-input>`, `<el-reasoning-card>`, `<el-tool-call>`, `<el-streaming-text>`, `<el-sources>`, and `<el-diff-viewer>` for AI interfaces.
